description: Registry of one-shot and looping sound effects, keyed by sound-effect ID and resolving to a CRI cue sheet plus cue name.

Id.technical: FName primary key. Producers supply this ID from many sources: hard-coded literals in character controllers, MapGround footstep/ground/jump/landing arrays, damage/effect/trap rows, script PlaySe/StopLoopSe commands, sequencer section IDs and NPC model-derived IDs. Status_FindSoundEffectRow walks DTM.SoundEffectDataTables (+0x730), rejects None by default, and returns the first typed row. Script loop SE handles are keyed by this same Id. Export spells it ID.

CueSheetName.simple: CRI Atom cue sheet containing the effect, or empty for the system sheet.
CueSheetName.technical: FString, default empty. Passed with CueName to SoundManager PlaySe/PlaySe3D/PlaySeLoop/Loop variants. An empty string maps to the built-in SE_System sheet in PlaySe, PlayAmbientSe and the shikigami loop path; PlaySe3D with an empty sheet instead uses its cue-name-only overload. Exported rows split between empty system cues and named character sheets.

CueName.simple: CRI cue name to play inside the sheet.
CueName.technical: FString, default empty. Used as the second argument of all SE playback calls and as the identity compared with UAtomComponent::GetCueName when the sequencer SetSeVolume track locates active SE/SE3D players to adjust their volume. No localization suffix is applied to SE cues in these consumers.

notes: Loaded as a DataTable primary asset named SoundEffectDataTable into DTM.SoundEffectDataTables (+0x730). There are many typed finder implementations and inlined table walks; all take the first row with a matching Id.
This table is a leaf lookup: sound-effect IDs live in Damage/Effect/MapGround/Character/Shikigami/Trap/script/sequencer data, and this row supplies the actual CRI sheet and cue.
An empty CueSheetName is intentional for system sounds; exported rows pair it with CueName values such as SE_SYS_000_01001.
The companion export contains 1,170 rows; retail completeness and Blueprint-only references are not asserted. Source is reconstructed retail C++ with retail RVAs recorded inline.

usages.detail: Shared typed row finder for sound-effect IDs.
PlaySe script command plays the row sheet/cue.
PlayLoopSe keeps a handle keyed by the row ID.
Footstep notify resolves a MapGround-provided ID and plays it at the hit location.
Character sound-effect calls resolve IDs from action data.
Effect system resolves row IDs into SE playback.
Sequencer SE playback resolves a row by SoundId.
Sequencer volume track resolves rows by section ID and matches active players by CueName.
